title: Successor map for record equality
statement: For a natural number $k$ and an index of the comparison, forward, backward, or verdict form, define a partial successor map from the phase type assigned to that index to an index together with its corresponding phase. At a completed comparison phase, a true flag moves to the forward pass when $j<k+2$ and otherwise to the backward pass with true flag; a false flag moves to the backward pass with false flag. A completed forward phase advances $i$ from $0$ to $1$, then returns to comparison at $j+1$; a completed backward phase advances $i$ from $0$ to $1$, then moves to the backward pass at the same $j$ with its flag. All other comparison, forward, and backward phases have no successor, and verdict indices have no successor in any phase.
hypotheses_covered: The input index has one of the comparison, forward, backward, or verdict forms, with the bounds and flags in its constructor
caveat: The backward-pass successor uses an auxiliary construction not defined in the supplied statement; its exact index and phase are therefore not fully specified there.
